statement: hid-nintendo reads the six MAC bytes in subcommand 0x02 device-info, formats a MAC string and assigns that string as evdev uniq for both main gamepad and separate IMU input node.

applicability.revision: dekuNukem b354f21 / Linux 4056b3c / SDL 535d80b / OpenPuck 29f4d1e (as cited); retail firmware not measured
applicability.scope: hid-nintendo.c 2477-2515, 2130-2134, 2188-2198. This is a host identity/association field and not physical Bluetooth pairing verification.
